title: `instr`, `locate`, `position`: 1-based characters, 0 when absent
description: `instr('héllo', 'l')`, `locate('l', 'héllo')` and `position('l' IN 'héllo')` are 3: code points from 1. Without a match they are 0. `instr(s, '')` is 1. `locate(t, s, start)` starts at `start` (1-based) and gives 0 for a start below 1. `instr(s, t, position, occurrence)` takes a 1-based start and the occurrence to find (1 by default), counting overlapping matches (`instr('aaaa', 'aa', 1, 3)` is 3). A negative position counts from the end and searches backwards: `instr('abcabc', 'b', -1)` is 5, `instr('abcabc', 'b', -3)` 2, `instr('abcabc', 'b', -1, 2)` 2. A position of 0, or one beyond either end (`instr('abc', 'b', 10)`, `instr('abc', 'b', -10)`), gives 0. An empty needle gives 1 at any position, negative ones included (`instr('hello', '', 3)` is 1). A NULL position or occurrence gives NULL.
reference: `strpos(s, t)` is the 1-based character position of the first match, 0 when there is none (#209). Spark is native.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark` runs each query four times on one local session: with `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` true and false, on the folded path (the optimizer evaluates a query over `VALUES` on the driver) and on the codegen path (`ConvertToLocalRelation` and `ConstantFolding` excluded, so the query runs as a job with whole-stage code generation). probes.json keeps one result per ANSI setting where the two paths agree. Spark 4.3.0 (pyspark 4.3.0), Java 21.0.12, Linux x86_64, `local[2]`, session time zone UTC, `spark.sql.timestampType=TIMESTAMP_NTZ`.

evidence.note: `position('bar' in 'foobarbar')` is 4, 1-based; NULL in, NULL out
`instr('你好世界你好', '你好', 1, 2)` is 5: positions in code points
`instr('abcabc', 'b', 0, 1)` is 0: a start of 0 finds nothing
`instr('abcabc', 'b', -1)` is 5: a negative start counts from the end
`instr('abcabc', 'b', -1, 2)` is 2: the second match from the end
`instr('abc', 'b', 10, 1)` is 0: a start past the end
`instr('abc', 'b', -10, 1)` is 0: a start before the beginning

provenance.notes: Spark's SQL query tests at tag v4.3.0: the golden files under results/ run with ANSI on, those under results/nonansi/ with it off.
